claims: C1 the assistant should not perform a prohibited action just because it is a translation of user-provided content
C2 the translation exception does not override policies other than those on restricted or sensitive content
C3 there is no good-cause exception for restricted and sensitive content policies
C4 the policy applies only to information, not actions

concepts.name: prohibited_action
concepts.gloss: an action the document's other policies forbid
concepts.inference: the clause refers to 'a prohibited action', which is defined by other clauses' prohibitions

asserts.read_back: performing % is forbidden when % is a translation of user-provided content and % is a prohibited action

closure.reason: the clause carves out from a prohibition rather than extending one; it says which policies still bind, so silence about an action leaves the translation permission standing
